title: GRN unit inputs added by the tag panel
description: Saved through the existing items[i][meta][unit][field] naming into gov_document_item_meta (row_index = unit_index). The acquisition date is not entered here: it is derived from the document's existing Supplier Challan date, else Purchase Order date. The service decides the tag kind; a typed asset_tag is rejected in enabled offices.

finance_source.description: Resolved by the server: product_type (valid default, read-only), line_choice (storekeeper chose in the warning's fix), none (no code: standard tag).

gov_code.description: Meta key gov_code; only submitted for line_choice. Must be an active Finance item whose UNSPSC is NULL or the product type's code.

tag_choice.description: auto: Govt. Tag when eligible, else standard. standard: the storekeeper explicitly keeps standard tags for this line (fix for a missing date or no code).

standard_tag_reason.description: Server-derived; frozen in the registration snapshot.

division_code.description: Meta key division_code; shown only when the office uses more than one division; defaults to the office default.

x-derived.needs_attention: Govt. Tag eligible line (has a Finance Code, tag_choice=auto, receiving source Purchase) but neither date is filled
x-derived.warning: finance_source=none and tag_choice=auto: units get standard tags

x-rejected: asset_tag is not part of this contract; a typed tag in an enabled office is a validation error.
